_meta.dataset: NYC MICHELIN Guide 2025/2026 Official Tier Counts, Ceremony Schedule & Verified Multi-Tier Selection

ceremony_2026.status_note: Confirmed on official Michelin North America press release (published 2026-08-11). As of 2026-11-26, the ceremony is 18 days away; the November 2025 New York selection remains the active MICHELIN Guide selection until December 14, 2026.

live_nyc_directory_counts.scope: New York City, USA and surroundings (live guide.michelin.com filter panel verified 2026-11-26)
live_nyc_directory_counts.filter_badge_audit_note: On guide.michelin.com/.../all-starred, the pill 'Distinction 3' indicates 3 active distinction checkboxes (1 Star, 2 Stars, 3 Stars), NOT 3 three-star restaurants. The live Distinction filter breakdown is 5 Three-Star (Le Bernardin, Per Se, Masa, Jungsik New York, Sushi Sho) + 14 Two-Star + 50 One-Star = 69 NYC-directory starred venues (vs. 72 in the November 2025 NY State release including Westchester venues such as Blue Hill at Stone Barns in Tarrytown).

_meta.pricing_methodology: Every two-adult figure is computed strictly from official restaurant menu/FAQ pages fetched on 2026-11-25/26 (either 2 x published per-person prix-fixe/tasting price or an itemized two-adult order from published à la carte prices). All amounts exclude NYC 8.875% sales tax, gratuity, and beverages unless stated. Where an official site did not publish dollar prices in accessible text, couple_cost_display is left blank and flagged unverified.

venues.name: Gramercy Tavern

venues.name: Crown Shy
venues.couple_cost_basis: Official dinner menu (crownshy.nyc/menus/): Gruyère Fritters ($18) + 1 starter/salad ($19–$26) + 2 mains/pastas ($80–$104, e.g. Honeynut $40, Citrus Chicken $49, Pork Katsu $52; or Short Rib for two $138) + Sticky Toffee Pudding for Two ($28) = $145–$210 pre-tax/tip/drinks.
venues.exceptions: Weekday lunch (Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00) verified on MICHELIN Guide listing; 2027 holiday exceptions unverified.

venues.name: COQODAQ
venues.couple_cost_basis: 2 x $52 per person for 'The Bucket List' signature fried chicken feast (consommé, ban-chan, two courses of gluten-free fried chicken, cold perilla noodles, soft-serve frozen yogurt) on official coqodaq.com/menus; excludes drinks, caviar add-ons, tax, and gratuity.
venues.exceptions: unverified for Feb–Mar 2027 holiday schedules; confirm via Resy.

venues.name: HanGawi
venues.couple_cost_basis: Official prix-fixe menu (hangawirestaurant.com/prix-fixe/): Weekend Mini Emperor's Lunch = 2 x $42 = $84 (min. 2 persons); Dinner Emperor's Tasting Menu = 2 x $99 = $198 (min. 2 persons); à la carte entrées $27–$28 each (~$98–$116 for two with starter & dessert). Excludes tax, tip, drinks.
venues.exceptions: Shoes-off dining room; 10 doors west of HGU New York (34 E 32nd St). 2027 holiday closures unverified.

venues.name: Dhamaka
venues.couple_cost_basis: Official menu (dhamaka.nyc/home): 1 starter/grill ($18–$25, e.g. Paneer Tikka $22, Kashmiri Gosht Chaamp $24) + 2 mains/biryani ($70–$114, e.g. Paneer Methi $38, Murgh Korma $39, Dhungar Gosht $49, Goat Neck Biryani $65) = $100–$146 pre-tax/tip/drinks.
venues.exceptions: Manages bookings directly (SevenRooms); Khad Khargosh rabbit requires advance pre-order. 2027 holiday hours unverified.

venues.name: Katz's Delicatessen
venues.address: 205 E. Houston St., New York, NY 10002
venues.couple_cost_basis: Official in-store menu (localmenu.katzsdelicatessen.com): 2 x Katz's Pastrami Sandwich ($30.95 each) = $61.90, or 2 x Reuben ($31.95 each) = $63.90; 3 Meat Platter = $51.95. Excludes drinks, sides, tax, and tip.
venues.exceptions: Counter ticket system (do not lose paper ticket); walk-in only, no reservations required.

venues.couple_cost_basis: Official menu (eightwoeightwo.com/menu): 2 shared small/large plates + dessert ($16–$24 small + $25–$35 shared mains + $10–$12 dessert) = $82–$106, or 2 x $70pp chef's choice menu = $140 pre-tax/tip/drinks.
